preferredProviderNudge.label: Preferred Provider Nudge
preferredProviderNudge.description: Surface preferred provider availability at low-demand times for high-propensity loyalist customers. Provider availability acts as the incentive — no discount required.

incentiveMidTier.label: Mid-Tier Time Shift Offer
incentiveMidTier.description: Offer 10% off for booking at a low-demand time slot. Targets mid-propensity customers (NPS 6–7 or lapsed 60–90 days). Combines with preferred provider surfacing where available.

incentiveLowTier.label: Low-Tier Recovery Offer
incentiveLowTier.description: Offer $10 off any time slot. Targets low-propensity customers (NPS ≤5 or lapsed 90+ days). Simplified booking flow, social proof surfaced.

membershipCta.label: Membership CTA (Post-Appointment)
membershipCta.description: Surface a membership sign-up call-to-action in the booking confirmation screen for non-members. Fires for all propensity tiers.
